findings: Shared last value-MLP bias dominates representation direction and dilutes relative neighbor contrast; adding a shared bias does not erase absolute differences.
Actual across-neighbor attention logits have very small spread; high-precision checks confirm nearly uniform weights.
Replacing attention with exact mean changes tokens by about 1e-6 relative or less on average.
Final optimizer moments show extremely small query/Q/K task-gradient scales relative to eps; changed tensors alone do not prove learned content selection.
limits: No reconstruction of unknown random initial Adapter; no claim about a unique training-history cause.
Internal bias/normalization probes are not new task-quality measurements.
No change to model code, original checkpoints, scoring resources, holdout or target evaluation.
next_minimal_candidate: Independently validate only the last value-MLP bias under a fixed protocol; do not jointly change gate, LR, temperature and retrieval.
